contexts.text: The place where they were stored up appeared like a manger in a stable... The manger in the stable, in which the purses lay, = spiritual instruction for the understanding. AR 255. SE 3605. a.
The manger as it were in a stable = spiritual nourishment for the understanding. This is signified by a manger, because a horse, which eats out of it, = the understanding.

A manger () = the doctrine of truth from the Word; from the fact that by horses is signified the understanding of the Word... Hence by a manger, where is the pasture of horses, is signified the doctrine of truth from the Word.
